root_cause: The single-request runner treated the USD cap in selection_status as descriptive metadata and had no executable preflight hard-cap guard for multimodal requests.
containment: No further paid visual request is permitted until the runner enforces a machine-readable cap before network execution.
required_corrective_actions: Represent the approved cap as a machine-readable configuration or budget field.
Compute a conservative preflight request-cost upper bound including image inputs and maximum output tokens.
Refuse execution when the preflight upper bound exceeds the approved cap.
Add tests proving rejection occurs before the API client is called.
